public_rationale: The condition needed to score this forecast has not been met in the available record. SoftBank confirmed completion of its follow-on investment on October 1, 2026. Reported executive departures do not establish that funding dried up or that employees fled to competitors because of it. Continued funding does not disprove a conditional prediction about what would happen without funding. With no deadline and no qualifying decisive event, the forecast remains unscored.
limitations: Not adjudicable applies to the unmet condition at this evaluation date, not to the claim being inherently uncheckable.
Completed financing does not establish permanent financial security.
The wording supplies no numerical threshold for a talent exodus.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If venture capital dries up, OpenAI will collapse and its talent will flee to competitors.

statement.excerpt: If the venture capital dries up, they are toast. Talent will make a beeline for competitors.

from_speaker: If the venture capital dries up
Talent will make a beeline for competitors
our_interpretation: Venture capital dries up means OpenAI loses practical access to new private equity funding needed to continue operating. It does not mean one investor delays or reduces a proposed investment.
Toast means business failure or inability to continue as a going concern.
Talent will make a beeline means a substantial, prompt movement of skilled employees to competitors following the funding cutoff; isolated departures do not establish it.
Both consequences are read as conditional on the funding cutoff.
No deadline is supplied. The nearby expression of doubt about a year of runway is not imported as a deadline for this conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: After a documented loss of access to needed private equity funding, OpenAI fails as a going concern and a substantial group of skilled employees moves promptly to competitors.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the funding cutoff is established, decisive evidence shows OpenAI permanently overcomes dependence on that funding while continuing operations, or an irreversible resolution establishes that one of the predicted consequences did not occur.

evidence.excerpt: Following the Third Tranche Investment, SBG has now completed the USD 30.0 billion follow-on investments in OpenAI previously announced.
evidence.explanation: Completed private investment is affirmative evidence against the funding-cutoff antecedent having occurred. It does not contradict the consequences Marcus predicts if funding subsequently disappears.

evidence.excerpt: Yesterday, news broke that Chris Malone, the company’s head of data centers, left the company last week after joining in March 2025.
evidence.explanation: A senior departure is relevant context, but this passage establishes neither movement to a competitor nor departure following a funding cutoff. It cannot satisfy the conditional forecast.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A documented funding cutoff would activate the test. Subsequent evidence of business failure and substantial employee movement to competitors, or an irreversible resolution defeating a necessary consequence, would permit assessment.
